_note: Multi-screen machines whose snapshot the page's screen-count guess (docs/app.js inferScreens) gets wrong: set -> {"k": number of displays in the picture, "horiz": side by side (true) or stacked (false)}. TX-1 and Buggy Boy are three screens side by side, each 256x240 in the snapshot's pixels, which the guess (every display 4:3) reads as two.
